fields.description: Stable Configurator API identity. Recipes may change design_name in the UI, but design_type is fixed by this front end.
Structured dimensions are echoed to the OpenSCAD console in lines beginning with DIM|. "full" adds per-door, per-shelf, and per-drawer assembled sizes.
Machine-readable design-health checks are echoed as CHECK|SEVERITY|CODE|MESSAGE for the website and package exporter.

Modular Organization v3 is a fork of Modular Storage v35.  The fork exposes physical connection interfaces, owned keepout zones, and compatibility keys as machine-readable records so project-level tools can reason about modules without duplicating the geometry rules.

enforce   = geometry-specific safe policies remain authoritative and interface keepout conflicts are validation errors. warn_only = keepout conflicts are reported as warnings. off       = suppress interface-owned keepout validation only.
What OpenSCAD displays/exports.
Circle/cylinder smoothness. Mostly affects round drill holes and CNC corner relief.
Stable colors make it easier to identify the same part in assembly and flat-layout views. "material" returns to a plywood-like single material palette; "monochrome" uses neutral gray.
Visual-only switches for inspecting the assembled model. Manufacturing outputs remain complete regardless of these settings.
Direct configuration. Recipe selection is now a web/UI concern; the geometry engine receives ordinary editable values.
Used only when cabinet_layout_mode = "mixed_bays". Valid bay types: drawers/drawer, door/doors, open/shelf/shelves. Example: ["drawers","drawers","door"]
Relative CLEAR opening widths. [1,1,2] makes bay 3 twice as wide.
Decorative gap between neighboring bay fronts. It is centered on the structural full-depth partition between the bays.

Normally leave this enabled. Full-depth partitions separate the bay openings and provide the inner mounting surfaces for drawers, doors, and shelf pins. Their joinery always follows the main carcass joinery_style.
Choose whether each horizontal axis is controlled by the outside cabinet envelope or solved backward from the required finished drawer interior.

"minimum" only grows an undersized cabinet; it never shrinks an existing outside envelope. "exact" resizes the cabinet to hit the requested finished drawer interior as closely as the construction rules allow.
direct       = use the target interior dimensions below. modular_grid = derive the target from pitch x module count + edge clearance.
1-based drawer-bank / mixed-bay slot whose clear width is used for solving. In ordinary single-bank cabinets leave this at 1.
Finished assembled drawer interior clear dimensions.
Generic modular-grid sizing. A 42 mm pitch is convenient for Gridfinity, but these controls intentionally remain storage-system agnostic. Required interior axis = pitch * count + 2 * edge_clearance.

The pattern is canonical for a given cabinet envelope so LEFT and RIGHT mating sides use the same coordinates. The engine detects conflicts with common side-panel operations and reports WARN| records rather than silently moving one cabinet to a different pattern.
Which OUTER cabinet side(s) receive the pattern.
standard = two vertical stations. tall     = three vertical stations.
Front/rear columns are measured from their respective cabinet edges. Matching cabinet depths are required for both columns to align.
Common furniture/cabinet alignment dowel starting point.
Clearance hole for sleeve/sex-bolt style cabinet connectors.
In dowel_connector mode the dowel and connector are separated vertically. 32 mm keeps the pair compatible with system-hole thinking without requiring the rest of the cabinet to use a 32 mm system.
Station centers keep this far away from the usable opening boundaries and cabinet extremes before snapping to the 32 mm canonical grid.
Conflict detector clearance around existing drilling/joinery.

choice for CNC joinery when you have measured the actual sheet thickness. Nominal inch selections convert the stated fraction directly to millimeters. Real plywood often measures thinner than its nominal label, so measure stock and use custom_mm when fit is critical.
Used whenever the matching stock selector above is set to custom_mm. Defaults intentionally preserve the existing Utility Cabinet geometry.
Select the physical mounting context directly.
Floor-base construction. Wall cabinets automatically suppress floor hardware.
Toe-kick dimensions; used only when base_style = "toe_kick".
Optional lower-front side-panel notch for a toe kick.
For leveling_feet / casters, a full-footprint mounting plate can be placed beneath the carcass. It uses carcass stock and is included in CUT/BOM.

Bottom-panel width. joined: existing carcass bottom fits between / joins into the side panels. full_width: bottom spans the full cabinet footprint; side panels sit on top of it. This is especially useful for caster/leveler loads when no separate mounting plate is used.
Hardware centers measured inward from the cabinet footprint.
Keep hardware drilling separate from CUT geometry. Export it with output_mode = "pocket_base_hardware".
Generic caster mounting plate / hole pattern.
Generic leveling-foot geometry / mounting hole.
Adds a separate work surface ABOVE the carcass top. This is independent of the internal full-top / stretcher construction below it.
Positive values extend beyond the cabinet footprint.

Matching alignment holes between the carcass top support and worktop. Support/stretcher holes are THROUGH. Matching worktop holes are BLIND pockets machined from the underside so the working surface stays clean.
Select a full sheet top or front/rear stretchers.

panel            = thin applied back, nailed/screwed around carcass edges. structural_panel = solid carcass-thickness back captured at the rear edge; it automatically follows carcass butt/dado/tab_slot joinery. stretchers        = structural rear rails made from carcass material. none              = open back.
Applied-panel position. Used only when back_style = "panel". structural_panel is always flush with the cabinet rear edge.
Structural rear stretchers. They sit inside the rear edge and use the same side-joinery style as the carcass (butt / dado / tab_slot).
One selector controls the fixed cabinet-to-side-panel joints.
Total added clearance around TAB/SLOT joints relative to the mating part. Positive values make the joint looser. Start small and cut a test coupon.
Independent clearance for CARCASS dados. This changes pocket width/length around the mating panel, not dado depth.
Blind dado depth into each cabinet side. Used only when joinery_style = "dado".

Tab count can be adaptive or fixed. "adaptive" is recommended: the count is calculated independently for each edge length so a 90 mm stretcher does not receive the same number of joints as a 600 mm shelf. Used only when joinery_style = "tab_slot".
Used only when tab_count_mode = "fixed".
Used by adaptive mode. This is an approximate span-per-tab target, not the actual gap. With the defaults, ~600 mm edges get about 3 tabs while ~90-100 mm edges get 1.
Joint geometry.
Minimum amount of solid material requested between adjacent tab/slot features. Adaptive mode will reduce the tab count before violating this.

CNC corner relief for square tabs: dogbone = diagonal relief, minimum material removal t_bone   = relief along the longest slot wall, preserving the other wall Leave "none" for laser cutting or if CAM handles relief.

Location-aware joinery inherited from Modular Storage v35 lets the same carcass use different tab placement policies at the bottom, top, fixed shelves, and drawer separators. legacy preserves the V34 evenly distributed behavior everywhere except the stackable bottom override; location_aware enables the selectors below.

automatic = historical evenly distributed tabs. edge_biased = move the first/last tab toward the ends while preserving the configured edge margin and minimum web. custom = use the matching *_tab_custom_centers array below.
Bottom joints are independently configurable on non-stackable cabinets.

Used only when joinery_style = "butt". These are through-holes in the cabinet SIDE panels, centered on the edge of each mating bottom/top/shelf/divider/separator/toe-kick part. They act as screw/pilot-hole guides so a butt-jointed part can be located consistently.

Shared mounting depth for decorative DOORS and DRAWER FACES. overlay     = current behavior: the front sits proud of the carcass face. inset_flush = the visible front surface is flush with the carcass front plane and the panel thickness extends into the opening.
Extra air space behind a flush/inset front. Drawer boxes, shelves, separators and slide hardware are automatically kept behind this plane.

"inset" is the historical narrow-overlay width: fronts stay between the side-panel outer edges but still sit proud of the carcass. "full_overlay" extends fronts across the side-panel front edges. inset_flush ignores this selector and fits each front inside its actual cabinet/bay opening using front_edge_reveal.
When true, the lowest visible front covers the front edge of the raised cabinet bottom. Drawer boxes / cabinet interior remain inside the opening.

fields.description: Gap between adjacent decorative doors.
Relative widths for side-by-side door bays. Only the first door_count entries are used. Equal weights preserve equal-width doors. Example: [1,1.5,2] creates progressively wider door bays.
For a DOORS-ONLY wall cabinet, extend decorative doors to the cabinet top. Combo cabinets intentionally stop below the drawer region.
fixed = built-in shelves using the selected carcass joinery_style. adjustable = loose shelves plus shelf-pin hole rows in both cabinet sides.
Number of shelf PANELS supplied. In adjustable mode their preview locations are evenly spaced, but they can be moved to any drilled shelf-pin position.
Adjustable-shelf geometry.
through works for CNC or laser. blind is more cabinet-like; export pocket_layout for the drilling operation.

Used by mixed bays of type "door" or "open". Each bay can independently use loose adjustable shelves or structural fixed shelves. Fixed shelves inherit the main carcass joinery_style at the bay boundaries (cabinet sides / full-depth mixed-bay partitions).
Number of shelf PANELS supplied in each bay.
Door pulls are placed near the opening edge, opposite the hinges.
Number of decorative doors in each mixed door bay. Supported values are 1 and 2. A two-door bay creates an equal pair that hinges at the OUTER bay edges and meets at the center using door_gap.

Used only for SINGLE-door mixed bays. Set the hinge side explicitly so the door can mount to either the cabinet side or neighboring full-depth partition. Paired doors ignore this array and automatically hinge left/right outward.

Basic starting points only. Verify all values against the selected hardware. euro_35mm = blind 35 mm cup pocket in door + fixing holes + cabinet plate holes screw_holes = no cup pocket; only door/cabinet mounting holes
One-door cabinets can choose which cabinet side carries the hinges. Two-door cabinets automatically hinge at the outer left/right edges.
Door-side geometry
Cabinet-side mounting-plate geometry. 37 mm front setback and 32 mm vertical spacing are common Euro-system starting points but MUST be checked against the selected hinge/plate.
Hardware presets may disable unsupported operations instead of leaving stale drilling.

full-depth vertical partition behind every inter-door gap. These partitions provide hinge mounting surfaces AND separate the door compartments. Partition-to-carcass joinery ALWAYS follows the main carcass joinery_style and uses the same fit/depth settings.
Clearance used for fixed-shelf cross-lap notches in the partitions.
Decorative applied drawer faces can be omitted for a simpler drawer. When omitted, optional handle holes move automatically to the box front.
Gap between adjacent decorative drawer faces.
Shared vertical sizing recipe. "graduated" makes lower drawers progressively taller. "custom_weights" uses one positive weight per drawer.
Drawer pulls are centered; this shifts them vertically from center.
Controls how an explicit hardware hole array is reduced for machining.
metal_slides = commercial side-mount slides wood_rails   = runners cut from the same sheet material none         = no slide allowance / runner geometry

fields.description: Multiple banks split the drawer region into side-by-side columns. "shared" = all banks use the shared drawer_count / height recipe. "independent" = each bank can use a different drawer count / height recipe.
Relative bank widths. Only the first drawer_bank_count entries are used. Example: [1,2] makes bank 2 twice the clear width of bank 1.
Used only when drawer_bank_layout_mode = "independent".
Decorative gap over structural bank partitions.
Vertical bank partitions.
Joinery between the drawer FRONT/BACK box panels and the drawer SIDES. These intentionally mirror the carcass choices.
Drawer tab/slot clearance is independent from the carcass.
Drawer dado clearance is independent as well. It applies to both front/back-to-side dados and optional drawer-bottom grooves.
Blind dado depth for drawer front/back-to-side joints.
Bottom joinery is independent. "dado" cuts a groove in all four drawer walls and enlarges the bottom so it enters those grooves. This can be used together with drawer_joinery_style = "tab_slot".
Optional structure between ADJACENT drawers. This does not replace the existing drawer/door combo divider.
A full separator is a broad horizontal panel. Stretchers create one front and one rear cross-piece at each drawer boundary.
Matching registration pattern between the drawer box FRONT and decorative drawer FACE. The drawer box front is always drilled through.
Moves the registration pattern relative to the drawer-box vertical center.
half_depth = blind hole from the REAR face, depth = 1/2 face thickness. through    = full through-hole in decorative face.
Total air gap is 2x this value. 12.7 mm is a common nominal 1/2" per side, but use the clearance specified by your exact slide hardware.
When enabled and drawer_mount = "metal_slides", through-holes are placed in BOTH cabinet side panels and drawer side panels.
Defaults are generic, not tied to a particular slide manufacturer.
legacy_spacing preserves the historic first-hole/spacing/count controls. explicit_array is used by hardware-catalog patches with manufacturer-specific patterns.
Fixed lower rail attached to the cabinet side.
Matching upper runner attached to the outside of each drawer side. Its underside rides on the top surface of the fixed rail.
Vertical location of the drawer runner, measured upward from the bottom of the drawer box. The fixed rail is automatically positioned underneath it.
Running clearances. side_clearance keeps the drawer runner away from the cabinet side; vertical_clearance prevents a zero-clearance/interference fit.

Matching holes are cut in: fixed rail <-> cabinet side drawer runner <-> drawer side This makes it easy to locate the rails with screws, dowel pins, or temporary registration pins before final fastening.

wood-slide horizontal side clearance Fit offsets are added to the configured clearance. Example with a configured 0.20 mm dado clearance: [-0.20,-0.10,0,0.10,0.20] tests 0.00 / 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30 / 0.40 mm.

Wood-slide offsets are intentionally biased upward because running clearance often needs more room than static joinery. With a configured 1.0 mm setting, the defaults test 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 mm PER SIDE.
Label size used by calibration_coupon_engrave.
Preview-only overlays in calibration_coupon_cut. They are excluded from exported SVG/DXF geometry.

engrave_layout exports ONLY vector part IDs plus the same registration frame used by CUT/POCKET layouts. Import it at the same origin as the cut file. The part IDs also match the IDs printed by output_mode = "bom".
Preview the cut-part outlines behind labels in OpenSCAD. The outlines use the preview-only % modifier and are NOT included in engraving exports.
Show exact blind-operation geometry over the cut layout in OpenSCAD. PREVIEW ONLY; it does not alter exported cut geometry.
Add the same outer dummy frame to CUT and POCKET layouts so OpenSCAD crops both exports to exactly the same extents/origin.
Usually leave this OFF and compensate in CAM.

Number of shelf PANELS supplied in each bay.
Door pulls are placed near the opening edge, opposite the hinges.
Number of decorative doors in each mixed door bay. Supported values are 1 and 2. A two-door bay creates an equal pair that hinges at the OUTER bay edges and meets at the center using door_gap.

Used only for SINGLE-door mixed bays. Set the hinge side explicitly so the door can mount to either the cabinet side or neighboring full-depth partition. Paired doors ignore this array and automatically hinge left/right outward.

Basic starting points only. Verify all values against the selected hardware. euro_35mm = blind 35 mm cup pocket in door + fixing holes + cabinet plate holes screw_holes = no cup pocket; only door/cabinet mounting holes
One-door cabinets can choose which cabinet side carries the hinges. Two-door cabinets automatically hinge at the outer left/right edges.
Door-side geometry
Cabinet-side mounting-plate geometry. 37 mm front setback and 32 mm vertical spacing are common Euro-system starting points but MUST be checked against the selected hinge/plate.
Hardware presets may disable unsupported operations instead of leaving stale drilling.

full-depth vertical partition behind every inter-door gap. These partitions provide hinge mounting surfaces AND separate the door compartments. Partition-to-carcass joinery ALWAYS follows the main carcass joinery_style and uses the same fit/depth settings.
Clearance used for fixed-shelf cross-lap notches in the partitions.
Decorative applied drawer faces can be omitted for a simpler drawer. When omitted, optional handle holes move automatically to the box front.
Gap between adjacent decorative drawer faces. Shared vertical sizing recipe. "graduated" makes lower drawers progressively taller. "custom_weights" uses one positive weight per drawer.
Drawer pulls are centered; this shifts them vertically from center.

fields.description: Multiple banks split the drawer region into side-by-side columns. "shared" = all banks use the shared drawer_count / height recipe. "independent" = each bank can use a different drawer count / height recipe.
Relative bank widths. Only the first drawer_bank_count entries are used. Example: [1,2] makes bank 2 twice the clear width of bank 1.
Used only when drawer_bank_layout_mode = "independent".
Decorative gap over structural bank partitions.
Vertical bank partitions.
Joinery between the drawer FRONT/BACK box panels and the drawer SIDES. These intentionally mirror the carcass choices.
Drawer tab/slot clearance is independent from the carcass.
Drawer dado clearance is independent as well. It applies to both front/back-to-side dados and optional drawer-bottom grooves.
Blind dado depth for drawer front/back-to-side joints.
Bottom joinery is independent. "dado" cuts a groove in all four drawer walls and enlarges the bottom so it enters those grooves. This can be used together with drawer_joinery_style = "tab_slot".
Optional structure between ADJACENT drawers. This does not replace the existing drawer/door combo divider.
A full separator is a broad horizontal panel. Stretchers create one front and one rear cross-piece at each drawer boundary.
Matching registration pattern between the drawer box FRONT and decorative drawer FACE. The drawer box front is always drilled through.
Moves the registration pattern relative to the drawer-box vertical center.
half_depth = blind hole from the REAR face, depth = 1/2 face thickness. through    = full through-hole in decorative face.
Total air gap is 2x this value. 12.7 mm is a common nominal 1/2" per side, but use the clearance specified by your exact slide hardware.
When enabled and drawer_mount = "metal_slides", through-holes are placed in BOTH cabinet side panels and drawer side panels.
Defaults are generic, not tied to a particular slide manufacturer.
legacy_spacing preserves the historic first-hole/spacing/count controls. explicit_array is used by hardware-catalog patches with manufacturer-specific patterns.
Fixed lower rail attached to the cabinet side.
Matching upper runner attached to the outside of each drawer side. Its underside rides on the top surface of the fixed rail.
Vertical location of the drawer runner, measured upward from the bottom of the drawer box. The fixed rail is automatically positioned underneath it.
Running clearances. side_clearance keeps the drawer runner away from the cabinet side; vertical_clearance prevents a zero-clearance/interference fit.

Matching holes are cut in: fixed rail <-> cabinet side drawer runner <-> drawer side This makes it easy to locate the rails with screws, dowel pins, or temporary registration pins before final fastening.

wood-slide horizontal side clearance Fit offsets are added to the configured clearance. Example with a configured 0.20 mm dado clearance: [-0.20,-0.10,0,0.10,0.20] tests 0.00 / 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.30 / 0.40 mm.

Wood-slide offsets are intentionally biased upward because running clearance often needs more room than static joinery. With a configured 1.0 mm setting, the defaults test 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 mm PER SIDE.

fields.description: Stable Configurator API identity. Recipes may change design_name in the UI, but design_type is fixed by this front end.

enclosure   = measure the existing cabinet opening and let the engine calculate the replacement drawer box. outside_box = reproduce / specify the finished outside box envelope. inside_clear= design the box around the required usable storage volume.
Measured clear opening width and height. Usable depth is measured from the enclosure/front reference plane to the rear obstruction/back panel.
When design_basis = enclosure, width/depth are derived from the opening. Height can be specified independently because replacement drawers commonly use a shorter box than the available opening.
[box_height, inside_clear, fill_opening]
Used when drawer_design_basis = outside_box.
Used when drawer_design_basis = inside_clear.
Used when drawer_design_basis = modular_grid. Required inside axis = pitch * count + 2 * edge clearance. 42 mm defaults are convenient for Gridfinity but remain fully generic.

none        = drawer box only / reuse the original front. overlay     = new face larger than the opening by the configured overlays. inset_flush = new face fits inside the opening with a perimeter reveal.
opening = derive from opening + overlay/reveal. custom  = use the explicit face width/height below.
Assembly-only translucent reference of the measured/required enclosure.
Structured dimensions are echoed to the OpenSCAD console in lines beginning with DIM|. "full" adds per-door, per-shelf, and per-drawer assembled sizes.
Machine-readable design-health checks are echoed as CHECK|SEVERITY|CODE|MESSAGE for the website and package exporter.

Modular Organization v3 is a fork of Modular Storage v35.  The fork exposes physical connection interfaces, owned keepout zones, and compatibility keys as machine-readable records so project-level tools can reason about modules without duplicating the geometry rules.

enforce   = geometry-specific safe policies remain authoritative and interface keepout conflicts are validation errors. warn_only = keepout conflicts are reported as warnings. off       = suppress interface-owned keepout validation only.
What OpenSCAD displays/exports.
Circle/cylinder smoothness. Mostly affects round drill holes and CNC corner relief.
Stable colors make it easier to identify the same part in assembly and flat-layout views. "material" returns to a plywood-like single material palette; "monochrome" uses neutral gray.

choice for CNC joinery when you have measured the actual sheet thickness. Nominal inch selections convert the stated fraction directly to millimeters. Real plywood often measures thinner than its nominal label, so measure stock and use custom_mm when fit is critical.
Used whenever the matching stock selector above is set to custom_mm. Defaults intentionally preserve the existing Utility Cabinet geometry.

Location-aware joinery inherited from Modular Storage v35 lets the same carcass use different tab placement policies at the bottom, top, fixed shelves, and drawer separators. legacy preserves the V34 evenly distributed behavior everywhere except the stackable bottom override; location_aware enables the selectors below.

automatic = historical evenly distributed tabs. edge_biased = move the first/last tab toward the ends while preserving the configured edge margin and minimum web. custom = use the matching *_tab_custom_centers array below.
